title: Karyalay Mail error catalog v1
description: Shape of errors/error-catalog-v1.yaml. The catalog is a transcription of karyalay-mail repository-spec-v1.0 Appendix E and §39; this schema constrains its form, never its content.

type_uri_template.description: RFC 9457 problem type URI template; {code} is the only placeholder (Repo 1 §26.1).

sources.description: Normative provenance for each part of the catalog.

code.description: Stable application error identifier (Master §23.1 grouping, Repo 1 Appendix E values).

http_status.description: Default HTTP mapping. An endpoint may reuse the code under a different status only where semantically valid (Appendix E preamble).

family.description: Bounded telemetry label. Derived mechanically as the first underscore-delimited segment of `code`. Repo 1 §40.3 permits error-family labels and forbids unbounded ones; Master §30.4 forbids high-cardinality labels.

type.description: The RFC 9457 `type` value a problem document carries for this code (Repo 1 §26.1).

ux_class.description: User-facing category from karyalay-webmail Appendix G. Null where that appendix does not map the code, meaning no browser surface renders it.

ux_behavior.description: Required client behavior from karyalay-webmail Appendix G. Null exactly when ux_class is null.

allOf.$comment: ux_class and ux_behavior are present together or absent together.
Repo 1 §39.1: SUBMISSION_STATUS_UNKNOWN is the catalog's only 202 — an ambiguous send outcome is accepted for reconciliation, not a failure.
